projects.title: Hotel Booking Data Analysis
projects.subtitle: Independent Project
bullets: Conducted exploratory data analysis on a hotel reservations dataset, applying data cleaning, quantile-based outlier detection, and distribution analysis (mean, median, standard deviation, KDE).

projects.title: YouTube Content-Based Recommender System
projects.subtitle: Independent Project
bullets: Designed and implemented a content-based recommendation system on 40,000+ real-world YouTube videos, applying TF-IDF vectorization and cosine similarity to model content relationships.
Conducted exploratory data analysis to investigate engagement patterns — including views-likes correlation and category-level performance — informing feature selection for the recommendation model.
Independently designed the experiment end-to-end: data acquisition, cleaning, feature engineering, model implementation, and evaluation.

projects.title: UPI Transaction Analysis Dashboard
projects.subtitle: Independent Project
bullets: Built an interactive Power BI dashboard analyzing UPI (Unified Payments Interface) transaction data across banks and time periods.
Designed multi-page report with dynamic slicers, column and line charts, and pivot tables for drill-down analysis of transaction patterns by bank and category.
Implemented interactive navigation using bookmarks and action buttons for a guided data exploration experience.
Applied data modeling and visualization best practices to transform raw transaction records into actionable business insights.
